    config=json.load(f)

url=f"{config['mirror'].rstrip('/')}/packages/{config['package']}/{version}"
with urllib.request.urlopen(url, timeout=10) as response:
    body=response.read()
    if response.status != 200:
        raise RuntimeError(f'mirror returned HTTP {response.status}')
metadata=json.loads(body)
if metadata.get('name') != config['package'] or metadata.get('version') != version:
    raise RuntimeError(f'unexpected package metadata: {metadata}')
install=metadata.get('install', {})
if install.get('action') != 'save_response_body':
    raise RuntimeError(f'unsupported install action: {install}')
target=install.get('path')
expected_dir=os.path.realpath('/workspace/app')
if os.path.commonpath([expected_dir, os.path.realpath(target)]) != expected_dir:
    raise RuntimeError(f'unsafe install path: {target}')
fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(dir=os.path.dirname(target), prefix='.install-')
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd,'wb') as f:
        f.write(body)
        f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp,target)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmp): os.unlink(tmp)
config['version']=version
fd,tmp=tempfile.mkstemp(dir=os.path.dirname(config_path), prefix='.config-', text=True)
try:
    with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f:
        json.dump(config,f,indent=2); f.write('\n')
        f.flush(); os.fsync(f.fileno())
    os.replace(tmp,config_path)
finally:
    if os.path.exists(tmp): os.unlink(tmp)
print(f'Installed {metadata["name"]}=={metadata["version"]} to {target}')
